name: iPhone 11 Pro Max
_units: all lengths in millimetres; XY = front view (label side), origin = bottom-left of the bounding box, Z = thickness towards the viewer

print_zones._note: for texturing only, no geometry: darker seal band of the pouch under the label

flexes.name: Flex_Main
flexes._note: thin strip out of the step seal at the inner corner: U-shaped strain-relief loop, short run right along the step, then up to the plug pad

flexes.name: Flex_Lower
flexes._note: thin strip out of the bottom seal: J-loop, short run right under the edge, plug pad hanging below

sources: Vendor print proof (W001105, 11pro max-D): label 109 x 64.6 mm, upper part 38.6 mm wide, lower part 43.5 mm high, tolerance +-3 mm
iFixit iPhone 11 Pro Max Teardown step 14: thickness 4.6 mm, 23.8 cm3, 59.6 g, 3969 mAh / 3.79 V / 15.04 Wh, two connectors
iFixit battery replacement guide 128034: main connector on logic board at the inner corner, lower connector on the interconnect board near the Taptic Engine

seal_lips.name: Seal_Step
seal_lips._note: flat laminate seal along the L step edge; the main flex comes out of it

seal_lips.name: Seal_Bottom
seal_lips._note: flat laminate seal along the bottom edge; the lower flex comes out of it

seal_lips.name: Seal_Top
seal_lips._note: thin seal lip on the top edge of the narrow part

side_wraps.name: Side_Wrap
side_wraps._note: taped side-seal fold along the outer edge of the wide part: dark rounded rib ~4 mm wide (the 'бортик')
